WITH claimed_event AS (
    INSERT INTO autofix.processed_log_event (
        elasticsearch_id,
        elasticsearch_index,
        correlation_id
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        NULLIF($3, '')
    )
    ON CONFLICT (elasticsearch_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING elasticsearch_id
),
upserted_incident AS (
    INSERT INTO autofix.incident (
        fingerprint,
        service_name,
        environment,
        exception_type,
        normalized_exception_message,
        application_stack_frame,

        first_seen_at,
        last_seen_at,
        occurrence_count,

        first_elasticsearch_id,
        last_elasticsearch_id,

        sample_correlation_id,
        sample_request_path,
        sample_http_method,
        sample_stack_trace,

        status
    )
    SELECT
        $4,
        $5,
        $6,
        $7,
        $8,
        $9,

        $10::timestamptz,
        $10::timestamptz,
        1,

        $1,
        $1,

        NULLIF($3, ''),
        NULLIF($11, ''),
        NULLIF($12, ''),
        NULLIF($13, ''),

        'DETECTED'
    FROM claimed_event

    ON CONFLICT (fingerprint)
    DO UPDATE SET
        last_seen_at = GREATEST(
            autofix.incident.last_seen_at,
            EXCLUDED.last_seen_at
        ),

        occurrence_count =
            autofix.incident.occurrence_count + 1,

        last_elasticsearch_id =
            EXCLUDED.last_elasticsearch_id,

        sample_correlation_id = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.sample_correlation_id,
            autofix.incident.sample_correlation_id
        ),

        sample_request_path = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.sample_request_path,
            autofix.incident.sample_request_path
        ),

        sample_http_method = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.sample_http_method,
            autofix.incident.sample_http_method
        ),

        sample_stack_trace = COALESCE(
            EXCLUDED.sample_stack_trace,
            autofix.incident.sample_stack_trace
        ),

        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING
        id,
        fingerprint,
        service_name,
        environment,
        exception_type,
        occurrence_count,
        status,
        jira_key,
        pull_request_url,
        occurrence_count = 1 AS is_new_incident
)
SELECT
    *,
    TRUE AS processed_now
FROM upserted_incident;
